scoring.rule: Only a ledger entry backed by pipeline artifacts and call audit records is scoreable.

METRIC-005.rule: Pass only when all 12 required domains have one completed, artifact-hashed, secret-scan-passing ledger entry.

execution_policy.provider_rule: Provider execution is prohibited unless --execute is supplied and Qwen configuration is valid; --mock never calls a real Provider.
execution_policy.failure_rule: Only transient transport failures receive one retry. A terminal failure stops the entire run and is atomically recorded.

identity.rule: canonical_path must equal the resolved source path and sha256 must equal the current source-question file digest.

question_source.runtime_binding: The manifest source path must equal app.workflow.pipeline.resolve_questions_path(), including SAGE_QUESTIONS_PATH when set.
question_source.item_binding: Each domains entry must include question and question_sha256. The question_id, domain, exact question text, and SHA-256(question UTF-8) must match its source questions[] item; approved mappings pin Q089 to materials and Q088 to engineering; replacement character U+FFFD (including Q109) is rejected.
question_source.rule: sha256 must equal the current source-question file digest.

manifest_contract.domains_rule: Exactly one ordered entry for every required domain, each with domain, question_id, question, and question_sha256.

artifact_policy.ledger: ledger.json (atomic replace; --resume accepts only the same canonical manifest hash and question_source_binding, which includes canonical source path, file SHA-256, and ordered item-binding digest)
artifact_policy.pipeline_artifacts: Use the artifact directory emitted by app.workflow.pipeline.run_pipeline_with_state.
artifact_policy.call_audit: Summarize state.llm_calls using app.core.call_audit.summarize_calls; do not serialize secrets.
artifact_policy.integrity: Each completed entry records a deterministic artifact hash and secret-scan outcome. Unknown token and cost values are null, never estimated.
